name: BSP_Session_DispatchEntityMessageToMember

name: BSP_GameWorld_SampleWaterHeight
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_inputs. float __thiscall(world, float x, float z), RET 8 at 0078CF74, body 0078CF20-0078CF76. Both callees take the same (x, z) pair and the same receiver [world+A8h]: 0078C890 at 0078CF3E (the wave field) and 00B9CF50 at 0078CF5F (a 0..1 coverage mask). The first result is spilled as a double at 0078CF49 and the second multiplies it with FMUL qword at 0078CF64, so the product is formed at x87 precision and rounded to float once by the FSTP at 0078CF69. Every caller subtracts the result from a point's world y to get a height above water (00932D5B in the buoyancy loop, 004462D0, the ship motion wave gate), so it is the water surface y at (x, z). Returns 0.0f for a flat sea, because 0078C890 returns FLDZ when the byte at field+F9h is set and the mask is 1.0f where no region covers the point. 31 callers. docs/OCEAN_HEIGHT.md | Run-time evidence, packet cc_exe_2j (bsp_game.exe milestone 2j): the routine runs whole in the executable over the USN02 mission's 32 ships, 8960 motion ticks, called at 00826985 from 00825f20 and at 00825972/0082599f from 008255b0. Its two leaves 0078c890 and 00b9cf50 are host records, because the receiver [[00E188A8]+19F0h] and its +A8h field object belong to the renderer/scene owner this process does not build; they answer the routine's own flat-sea pair (wave 0.0f, mask 1.0f) and the product at 0078cf64 is exactly 0.0f. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2j.

name: BSP_GameWorld_BisectWaterCrossing
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_projectile_helpers, read-only analysis. __thiscall void(World* this = ECX = [[00E188A8]+19F0h], float3* out hidden, float3 from by value, float3 to by value); body 0078D1B0-0078D3C8. A bisection, not an interpolation. Midpoint at 0078D1B9-0078D212, each component sum stored to a float before the double 0.5 at 00D7A280. Refuses a segment whose |to.y - from.y|, folded to an absolute value through the -0.0f at 00D7A208, is not above the double 0.01 at 00CE6638 (0078D249-0078D257), returning the plain midpoint. Length from 0042B2F0 at 0078D277; the loop runs only while it exceeds the FLD1 at 0078D280 and halves it each pass, so the result is accurate to about one world unit. Each pass samples 0078C890 and 00B9CF50 on [this+A8h] (0078D2A8, 0078D2C2), that is 0078CF20 inlined, and keeps the half that still straddles the surface. Returns the fresh midpoint when the last probe was submerged, else the far endpoint (0078D3A3-0078D3AF). Sole callers 0084B380 and 0084B4B0. Samples at the midpoint's (x, y) where 0078CF20's contract is (x, z). docs/PROJECTILE_HELPERS.md
